run_merge_traj: run the merge_traj script to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into a single full trajectory file
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_checkpoints_to_traj: merge intermediate VASP relaxation checkpoints into a single ASE trajectory file for an adsorbate run
extract_vasprun_from_checkpoint: extract vasprun.xml from a VASP checkpoint zip file and save it with an indexed name
build_full_trajectory: build a full ASE trajectory by concatenating frames from multiple VASP checkpoint vasprun.xml files
